chose: A phrase's score is its nearest intent's cosine with the hunch's words under potion-multilingual-128M. A hit is every phrase at or above THRESHOLD = 0.75 and within NEAR = 0.1 of the best, closest first. Both numbers were set from the real model's scores over the 14 seed phrases (server docs/phrases.md, "The threshold").
options: 0.6: more paraphrases hit, but unrelated sentences sharing words hit too ("call me later" 0.615 to where-is-my-phone, "this food is amazing" 0.628 to did-you-eat)
the best phrase alone, with no runners-up
gray: A static model is coarse. Honest paraphrases below 0.75 miss ("grab lunch together" 0.497, "I'm swamped today" 0.417), and "see you tomorrow" sits at 0.746 to will-it-rain-tomorrow, just under the line. A miss is kept for KP5, so a miss costs less than showing a wrong phrase.
